facts: flutter_lints is the official recommended lint set for Flutter apps.

en.label: Static analysis
en.name: flutter_lints
en.summary: Use the official Flutter lint set.
en.description: The default quality bar. Combine with analyzer language strictness when you want more type safety.
tradeOffs: Does not enable strict-casts by itself
Team rules may still be missing
recommendedWhen: You want the default Flutter bar
avoidWhen: You already need strict language modes and custom_lint

zh.label: 静态分析
zh.name: flutter_lints
zh.summary: 使用官方 Flutter lint 集。
zh.description: 默认质量门槛。若要更强类型安全，可再打开 analyzer 的 language 严格选项。
advantages: 每个 Flutter 仓库都认识
recommendedWhen: 想要默认 Flutter 门槛
avoidWhen: 已经需要严格语言模式和 custom_lint

ja.label: 静的解析
ja.name: flutter_lints
ja.summary: 公式の Flutter lint セットを使います。
ja.description: 標準の品質バーです。型安全を足すなら analyzer の language 厳格化と組み合わせます。
advantages: どの Flutter リポジトリでも通じる
tradeOffs: strict-casts は自動では入らない
チームルールは別途不足し得る
recommendedWhen: Flutter の標準バーが欲しい
avoidWhen: すでに厳格な言語モードと custom_lint が必要
